notes.title: 1.0.4 Update
notes.content: Fixed the bug of interaction between active target and equipment target

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 Update
notes.content:
Adjustments:

Exploration items such as "Silencing Stone" and "Woodcutting Axe" are no longer required to be carried during exploration.
The "Uncontrollable" Buff effect has been changed to: "At the start of the character's turn," reduce their "number of actions" by 1 (50%).

Purple Abyss Area Adjustments:

All options in the "Eerie Ritual" have a chance to trigger a battle.
All options in "Mind Invasion" have a chance to trigger "Uncontrollable."
In "Purgatory" difficulty tasks, the number of "Eerie Ritual" events has increased.

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Update
notes.content:
Fixes:

Bug where killing enemies in the "pre-battle" phase would not end the battle
Additions:

"Wandering Merchant" can be refreshed by spending currency: 9 Manuscripts, 3 Rings, 1200 Gold
"Hero Station" can be refreshed by spending currency: 4 Keys, 4 Rings, 4 Manuscripts
"General Store" can be refreshed by spending currency: 3 Keys, 4 Rings, 800 Gold
